attempted_claim: Let P^N(2)=Sigma^{N-2} RP^2 (N>=3) be the mod-2 Moore space, localized at 2. For N=4m+1 with m>=2, is 4*pi_k(P^{4m+1}(2))=0 for every k<=16m-3? Equivalently, is the fourth-power map 4: Omega^2 P^{4m+1}(2) -> Omega^2 P^{4m+1}(2) null-homotopic on restriction to the skeleton sk_{16m-5}(Omega^2 P^{4m+1}(2))? In particular, does any Z/8-summand occur in pi_k(P^{4m+1}(2)) below four times the connectivity, or does exponent 4 hold throughout that range?
decisive_failure: The investigation is limited in three concrete ways. First, the elementary cofiber LES route (Route A) was refuted by a distributivity self-check: degree-2 postcomposition is not multiplication by 2 on higher homotopy of spheres, so no uniform 4-torsion or separation corollary follows. Second, the Goodwillie/Snaith route (Route B) and EHP/Whitehead route (Route C) locate genuine obstructions inside the target skeleton range but their unstable-Adams/Bockstein differentials and uniform m-dependent Whitehead divisibility for n=4m-1 could not be decided with local resources, as confirmed by the failed m=2 bounded recovery test. Third, literature triage used the single permitted search only to prevent overclaiming: it confirmed N=1 mod 4 is the open complement of the published Mikhailov-Wu N=0 mod 4 exponent-4 theorem and that no local transfer of its Mahowald-type input was available. No counterexample and no null-homotopy was constructed.
